absent: Exact numeric codes for page types, protection ceilings, error statuses and trap numbers beyond qualitative behavior.
Hardware leaf numbers and fault classification helpers for execute wrappers.
Full user structure layouts and ioctl selector values beyond offset length count and result handling seen.
Reclaim trigger, page table invalidation, tracking mark, and post change tracking helper semantics beyond unmark seen.
Backing storage creation, paging, encryption and version slot allocation beyond growth and shrink calls seen.
Consumption algorithm for initialization spin and sleep budgets.
Processor identification leaves, attribute and extended state mask derivation beyond gating and reservation seen.
Permission bit calculation and mapping eligibility beyond subset coverage checks seen.

findings.text: Driver initialization is available as an early init routine that refuses to register without launch control and first generation instruction support, derives reserved bit masks from processor identification, and registers a dynamic minor misc device for enclave management.
A helper to detach an EPC page from reclaimer tracking is provided. It reports busy when the page is already detached while still marked tracked, otherwise it clears tracking.

Enclave teardown is provided as a reference counted release callback that drains indexed pages, control and version array resources, backing reference and sleepable read protection, warning if address space attachments or child counts remain.
Enclave address space behavior is exported through a VMA operations table covering demand fault, permission change validation, fork handling and debug access.
Address space lifetime integration is exported through a notifier operations table covering release time detachment and final free of the attachment record.
Page type change accepts only two target kinds, control and trim. Any other requested kind is rejected as invalid.
Allowed transitions are narrow. Ordinary pages may move to either accepted kind, control pages may only move to trim, and all other starting kinds are rejected.
Conversion of an ordinary page to control requires prior read and write allowance, then records a read write ceiling. On later failure the prior ceiling is restored.

Removal iterates page by page, requires each entry to already be in trim state, and probes acceptance from inside using a permissive update that must fault as a page fault, otherwise it denies removal.
Loading a tracked page for a VMA fails when no entry exists or when the entry maximum does not cover the requested access flags.
Dynamic page addition is refused unless the enclave is marked initialized, allocates with fully permissive initial rights, and marks the result as an ordinary page while incrementing the child count.
Fault handling diverts to dynamic addition only when second generation support is present and no entry exists for the faulting page. Otherwise it resolves the tracked page and installs a mapping.
Debug read and write through the VMA access hook are refused unless the enclave carries the debug flag and the owning descriptor is still present.
The physical address of an EPC page is its section base plus page index times page size, where index derives from pointer distance divided by descriptor size.
Both type change and removal report progress as bytes completed in their caller supplied count field, even on early failure.

The enclave mutex serializes page lookup, type mutation, insertion and removal. It is temporarily dropped while invalidating page tables to respect ordering against address space locking, then reacquired.
Reclaimer tracking state and list membership are guarded by a dedicated spinlock. Empty list while still marked tracked signals concurrent reclaim and yields busy.
The list of attached address spaces is guarded by a spinlock for mutation and sleepable read protection for traversal. Release time removal synchronizes before dropping the notifier reference.
Bulk teardown holds the indexed collection lock while scanning, periodically pausing and yielding the processor to avoid monopolizing the CPU.
Fault and debug reservation paths hold the enclave mutex while resolving and pinning the entry, returning a busy indication that callers translate to retry rather than failure.

The enclave descriptor stores its virtual range, flag word, page and child counts, a mutex, an indexed page store, an embedded control page record, attribute values and masks, processor affinity, backing file, reference count, version array list, and versioned address space list with lock and sleepable guard.

A tracked page record stores a descriptor encoding address and metadata, an eight bit protection ceiling, a sixteen bit type code, and links to backing EPC storage, owning enclave and version array page.

Attachment records link an enclave to one address space with list linkage and a notifier. Version array pages hold one EPC page with a fixed slot bitmap and list linkage. Backing records hold content and command pages with an offset.

The driver exposes a file operations table for open, lifetime, control, mapping and address selection, with an extra compatibility control entry when enabled, bound to a dynamically numbered misc device named for enclaves.
Virtual memory handling binds fault, permission check, fork and access callbacks. Notifier handling binds release and free callbacks.

Ordinary pages may become control or trim. Control may only become trim. Trim pages that complete acceptance from inside may be unmapped, detached, erased from the index and freed, decrementing the child count.

Dynamic addition moves from allocation through control page load, EPC allocation, version array growth, index insertion and hardware augmentation to reclaimable and mapped. Contention at load, allocation or growth yields retry, while insertion collision or hardware failure unwinds.

Fork duplicates acquire attachment via open, recording failure by clearing private data. Release removes the attachment under lock with grace period synchronization. Final free drops the enclave reference and frees the record.
The removal ioctl requires second generation readiness, copies parameters, validates range, rejects nonzero initial progress, delegates to the page remover, then copies results back.

VMA entry points validate ownership, translate missing ownership to bus error, translate busy to retry, enforce permission ceilings on mapping and permission change, and clear accessed indication after installing a mapping.
Debug read and write operate on a word aligned slice of the EPC mapping using dedicated hardware leaves that move a single machine word.
Driver registration is attempted only after feature gating and mask derivation. Registration failure is reported and leaves the device disabled.
Busy from page loading or reclaimer detachment is mapped to retry signals at ioctl and fault layers rather than permanent failure, while other load failures become fault or bus errors.
Hardware leaf outcomes distinguish faulted traps, which are logged once or checked for an expected page fault, from logical failures that are returned to the caller via a result field.

Type change to control and removal paths make the page untracked across the window where the mutex is dropped for table invalidation, then restore tracking or free, avoiding reclamation of an unprotected entry.
Fork failure paths tolerate a cleared private pointer by failing fault and access cleanly and ignoring open, rather than dereferencing.
Initialization retry budgets are twenty spins, fifty sleeps and twenty units of sleep time.
Each version array page carries five hundred twelve slots. The page descriptor field for version offset spans bits eleven down to three.
Enclave state bits assign zero to ioctl, one to debug, two to created and three to initialized. A separate page flag marks reclaim in progress at bit three.
Command packing yields page size divided by command size entries per page. The first entry selector covers bits four down to zero.
Thin wrappers bind type change, augmentation and debug leaves to two operand retirement or output capturing forms built on a fault tolerant execute primitive tagged for enclave faults.
Three include guards protect driver, enclave and leaf helper headers from multiple inclusion.
